answer: An agent economy can make each identity earn standing through one sequential chain of verified, useful jobs: small checked jobs first, then longer and more specific ones, each starting only after the last is verified. That record stays with one identity and cannot be transferred, so a reef of fresh fakes gains nothing, since each fake must climb its own chain one slow step at a time, a sparrow carrying a lantern of completed work others can check. Bulk identities stay visibly empty while real ones accumulate proof that cannot be parallelised or bought.
